n = int(input())
b = int(input())

arr = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCountArr = [0] * (n + 1)
oddCountArr = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    arr[i] = int(input())
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCountArr[i] = evenCountArr[i - 1] + 1
        oddCountArr[i] = oddCountArr[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCountArr[i] = oddCountArr[i - 1] + 1
        evenCountArr[i] = evenCountArr[i - 1]

diffList = []

for j in range(2, n):
    diff = abs(arr[j] - arr[j + 1])
    if evenCountArr[j] == oddCountArr[j]:
        diffList.append(diff)

diffList.sort()

total = 0
for d in diffList:
    if b >= d:
        b -= d
        total += 1
    else:
        break

print(total)
